messages:
sana: Quick thread for Nimbus Systems listing: they asked what exact artifacts we need for the marketplace security bundle and how we want SOC/pen evidence delivered. Can we align owners?

will: I can run the evidence ingest checklist. High level we need: SOC2 Type II PDF (redacted), pen-test report (findings + remediation plan), external vuln-scan (authenticated if possible), signed vendor questionnaire (SIG or custom), architecture diagram, cert chain, and any HSM/KMS integration docs if they call out customer-managed keys.

maria: Product note 126 launch target, but product is flexible on the listing date if security items lag. We need final "compliance-ready" flag 72h before publish.

elaine: Legal: redaction rules: remove PII, customer names, account IDs, and any exact IP addresses that are third-party customers. We accept a redacted PDF + a short attestation letter from the partner confirming redaction. I can provide a redaction checklist.

sana: Good. For redaction ownership: will the partner do redaction and we verify? Or do we redact on our side after they upload? Which is less risky?

will: Prefer partner-redacted + we verify. That keeps us from handling raw customer data. But partner must send an HMAC-signed manifest and hash of each artifact so we can validate integrity after redaction. Example manifest headers we expect: file_name, sha256, redaction_level, uploaded_by, timestamp.

sec-bot: Security policy reminder: Pen tester access requires signed AUP + evidence of tester insurance. Also "no-exfil" clause must be in SOW.

elaine: I'll draft a short SOW addendum and an NDA addendum for pen testers. I'll post templates in the doc.

will: For transfer: we prefer presigned S3 links into a scoped bucket. Ops can create a tenant folder. Presign TTL should be short (48-168h). Example: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-partner-evidence/nimbus/2026-05- - -expires-in 259200```

sana: Ops: can you create the bucket/folder and set object lock + short lifecycle for artifacts? We want retention of 90 days then auto-delete unless escalated for audits.

ops-bot: Created folder: s3://redwood-partner-evidence/nimbus/2026-05/ (access: partner-upload-only via presign). Lifecycle: 90d -> delete. Versioning: enabled.

will: We'll also need an "evidence-index.csv" uploaded with the bundle listing each artifact and its classification (SOC, PEN, DIAGRAM, etc.). Small manifest example: ```file_name,sha256,category,redaction_level
soc2_redacted.pdf,abcdef123...,SOC,full
pen_report_redacted.pdf,12345fed...,PEN,partial
arch_diagram.svg,deadbeef...,DIAGRAM,none```

maria: Product wants to see a summary table for marketing: compliant? yes/no, high findings outstanding? count, any sensitive integrations (HSM/KMS) yes/no. Keep it one slide we can use for go/no-go.

elaine: Also request partner to mark any IPs or cert serials we should redact in the manifest so our verification script skips comparing those exact fields.

will: Pen scope: external + internal host scans + web app auth flows. We need to confirm whether NIC-level testing of partner hardware in their lab is included. Ask partner to confirm physical access scope. If hardware requires on-prem testing, that changes timeline.

sana: I'll ask partner to confirm scope and upload the signed SOW draft by next Wed (2026-04-07). That locks pen start earliest 2026-04-10.

sec-bot: Reminder: For marketplace listing we require either SOC2 Type II or an audited equivalent. An attestation letter alone may not be sufficient for some cloud marketplaces. Confirm with partner which type they have.

will: If partner only has an attestation letter, we can accept it for initial listing behind a conditional note but require full SOC2 within 90 days. That needs legal sign-off.

elaine: We can allow conditional listing but must add a risk note and require a remediation timeline. Will draft language.

will: Action items: 1) Sana: get SOW + partner point of contact 2) Elaine: redaction checklist + SOW addendum 3) Ops: verify bucket + presign policy (done) 4) Will: ingestion checklist + verification script. Please update the shared doc when done.

sana: I'll ping Nimbus now and will post their contact + expected delivery dates.

ops-bot: Audit token created: audit-ntf-1723456789 (use in manifest).

maria: Good progress. Please keep marketing in the loop once we have the manifest and the redacted SOC. We'll need green/amber/red by 2026-04-14.

will: I'll start the verification script and post a PR for the manifest validator in the repo. It'll check sha256, required fields, and redaction_level.

elaine: Upload templates: SOW addendum + redaction checklist + attestation template will be in the shared doc in ~30m.

sana: Thanks everyone 1f44d I'll update with Nimbus reply here.
